title.zh: SRP 倒數 12 天仍未上線、CRA 標準交付期限延後兩個月、Citrix NetScaler 由 DoS 變成免認證 RCE 遭利用
title.en: SRP Not Live with 12 Days to Go; CRA Standard Delivery Deadlines Slip Two Months; Citrix NetScaler Turns from DoS into Exploited Unauthenticated RCE

summary.zh: 距 CRA 9/11 通報義務生效只剩 12 天，ENISA 單一通報平台（SRP）仍未上線：公開網址未公布、國家 CSIRT 協調員名單未公布、不提供 API。這代表義務生效當週，第一線只能靠人工介面通報，內部流程必須以「24 小時內完成人工提交」為前提設計，不能寄望自動化。CRA 標準面出現兩件方向相反的事：ETSI 已於 8/13 把 17 項產品類別標準（EN 304 617–627、631–636）送進公眾意見徵詢，是迄今最大一批進展；但執委會同時擬修訂標準化委託 M/606，把 2026 年的交付期限整體往後推兩個月（A 類與 B 類漏洞管理標準由 8/30 移到 10/31、C 類產品標準由 10/30 移到 12/31）。法規適用日一天都沒動，往後推的只有標準——換句話說，「等調和標準出來再開始準備」的空窗又拉長了兩個月，而 2027/12/11 的主要義務日不變。ISO 面，ISO/IEC 27017:2026 已於 7 月發布第二版，時隔 11 年首次改版並全面對齊 27002:2022 的控制結構，用雲端服務的組織需重新對照。漏洞面本週相當熱：CISA 三度更新 KEV 共新增 10 項，其中 Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 原本被列為 DoS，watchTowr 8/14 公布 PoC 後被證實可達免認證遠端執行，隨即遭實際利用投放 web shell；另有 JFrog Artifactory 路徑穿越漏洞入列，直接打在軟體供應鏈的建置產出物儲存庫上。
summary.en: With 12 days to the CRA's September 11 reporting obligations, ENISA's Single Reporting Platform is still not live: no public URL, no published list of national CSIRT coordinators, and no API. In practice that means the first week of the obligation will run on a manual interface, so internal processes must be designed around completing a human submission inside 24 hours rather than around automation. Two opposite things happened on CRA standards: ETSI put 17 product-category standards (EN 304 617–627 and 631–636) into Public Enquiry on August 13 — the largest batch of progress so far — while the Commission drafted an amendment to standardisation request M/606 that pushes the 2026 delivery deadlines back two months (Type A and the Type B vulnerability-management standards from August 30 to October 31; Type C product standards from October 30 to December 31). None of the regulation's application dates moved; only the standards did — so the gap in which "wait for the harmonised standard" is not a viable plan just grew by two months, with December 11, 2027 unchanged. On the ISO side, ISO/IEC 27017:2026 was published in July as the second edition — the first revision in eleven years — realigning cloud guidance onto the ISO/IEC 27002:2022 control structure, which organisations using cloud services will need to re-map. Vulnerabilities were busy: CISA updated the KEV catalog three times this week, adding ten entries. Among them, Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 was originally rated a DoS bug, but after watchTowr published a proof of concept on August 14 it was shown to allow unauthenticated remote code execution and was promptly exploited to drop web shells. A JFrog Artifactory path-traversal flaw also entered the catalog, landing squarely on the build-artifact repository at the heart of the software supply chain.

highlights.zh: 【重點追蹤】EU CRA：距 9/11 通報義務生效僅 **12 天**，ENISA 單一通報平台仍未上線、網址未公布、CSIRT 協調員名單未公布、**不提供 API**。通報流程請以「人工介面、24 小時內完成」為設計前提。
highlights.en: [Watch] EU CRA: just **12 days** to the September 11 reporting obligations, and ENISA's Single Reporting Platform is still not live — no URL, no CSIRT coordinator list, and **no API**. Design your reporting process around a manual interface completed within 24 hours.

highlights.zh: 【重點追蹤】CRA 調和標準：ETSI 8/13 將 17 項產品標準送進公眾意見徵詢（含路由器/交換器、作業系統、VPN、SIEM、密碼管理器、連網玩具等）；但執委會同時擬把 2026 年交付期限延後兩個月，**OJ 迄今仍無任何 CRA 調和標準**。
highlights.en: [Watch] CRA harmonised standards: ETSI opened Public Enquiry on 17 product standards on August 13 (routers/switches, operating systems, VPNs, SIEM, password managers, connected toys and more), while the Commission drafted a two-month slip to the 2026 delivery deadlines. **Still nothing cited in the Official Journal.**

highlights.zh: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway **CVE-2026-8452 已遭實際利用**：原廠 6/30 僅列為記憶體溢位與 DoS，watchTowr 8/14 公布 PoC 後證實可達免認證 RCE，攻擊者投放 web shell。CISA 8/26 列入 KEV，要求 8/29 前修補。設為 Gateway（SSL VPN／ICA Proxy／CVPN／RDP Proxy）或 AAA 虛擬伺服器者受影響。
highlights.en: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway **CVE-2026-8452 is being exploited in the wild.** Citrix rated it a memory-overflow DoS on June 30; after watchTowr published a PoC on August 14 it was shown to permit unauthenticated RCE, and attackers began dropping web shells. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on August 26 with an August 29 remediation date. Appliances configured as Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or as an AAA virtual server are affected.

highlights.zh: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 發布（第二版，睽違 11 年改版）：獨立的雲端專屬（CLD）控制措施由 7 項精簡為 4 項，其餘併回 ISO/IEC 27002:2022 對應控制，結構全面對齊 27002:2022；歐洲同步採認為 EN ISO/IEC 27017:2026。
highlights.en: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 has been published (second edition, the first revision in eleven years): the standalone cloud-specific (CLD) controls drop from seven to four, with the rest folded into their ISO/IEC 27002:2022 counterparts and the whole structure realigned to 27002:2022. Europe has adopted it in parallel as EN ISO/IEC 27017:2026.

name.zh: EU AI Act（歐盟人工智慧法案）

title.zh: 【重點追蹤】調和標準：OJ 仍無任何 AI Act 標準；prEN 18228（風險管理）意見徵詢已於 7/30 結束
title.en: [Watch] Harmonised standards: still nothing in the OJ; the prEN 18228 (risk management) enquiry closed on July 30

content.zh: 本期無新的刊登動作：歐盟公報（OJ）迄今仍未刊登任何 EU AI Act 調和標準，Article 40 的合規推定對高風險系統提供者尚不可用。CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 的管線現況為：EN 18286（Article 17 品質管理系統）已於 7/12 核准發布、等待執委會評估與刊登決定；prEN 18228（AI 風險管理，對應 Article 9）的公眾意見徵詢已於 7 月 30 日結束，接下來是意見處理與正式表決；prEN 18229-1、prEN 18282 同處意見徵詢階段；對應 Article 10 資料治理的 prEN 18284 仍在起草。時間帳要算清楚：高風險義務因數位總括法（Digital Omnibus，2026-07-24 刊登 OJ、07-27 生效）已延至 Annex III 2027-12-02、Annex I 2028-08-02，標準必須在那之前完成「發布 → 執委會評估 → 刊登 OJ」三道程序才有推定效力，而目前連第一份都還沒走完第三道。
content.en: No new citation this period: the Official Journal still carries no EU AI Act harmonised standard, so the Article 40 presumption of conformity remains unavailable to high-risk system providers. The CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 pipeline currently stands as follows. EN 18286 (Article 17 quality management system) was approved and published on July 12 and now awaits Commission assessment and a citation decision. The public enquiry on prEN 18228 (AI risk management, mapping to Article 9) closed on July 30, with comment resolution and a formal vote to follow. prEN 18229-1 and prEN 18282 are also at enquiry, while prEN 18284, covering Article 10 data governance, is still in drafting. The arithmetic matters: the Digital Omnibus (cited in the OJ on 2026-07-24, in force 2026-07-27) moved high-risk obligations to 2027-12-02 for Annex III and 2028-08-02 for Annex I, and a standard must clear publication, Commission assessment and OJ citation before it confers any presumption — and not even the first one has cleared the third step.

action.zh: 高風險 AI 系統的提供者現在就可用 EN 18286 文本做 Article 17 的差距分析，但在文件與客戶溝通中不得聲稱已取得合規推定。風險管理流程建議先對照 prEN 18228 的公開草案佈局，待正式表決版本出來時只需微調而非重做。若貴司產品屬 Annex I（內嵌於受產品安全法規範產品中的 AI），實質準備期到 2028-08-02，但供應鏈客戶的合約要求通常會早於法定期限出現。
action.en: Providers of high-risk AI systems can already gap-assess against the EN 18286 text for Article 17, but must not claim a presumption of conformity in documentation or customer communications. Lay out your risk-management process against the published prEN 18228 draft now, so the formally voted version requires tuning rather than a rebuild. If your products fall under Annex I (AI embedded in goods covered by EU product-safety law), the substantive runway extends to 2028-08-02 — though supply-chain customers' contractual requirements typically land well before the legal deadline.

title.zh: Article 50 透明度義務已生效：執委會 7/20 通過指引，並推出 AI 生成內容透明度自願行為準則
title.en: Article 50 transparency obligations are live: the Commission adopted guidelines on July 20 and issued a voluntary Code of Practice on transparency of AI-generated content

content.zh: AI Act Article 50 的透明度義務自 2026 年 8 月 2 日起適用，涵蓋四類情境：(1) 與人直接互動的 AI 系統須告知使用者正在與 AI 互動；(2) 生成合成音訊、影像、影片或文字者須以機器可讀方式標記；(3) 情緒辨識與生物特徵分類系統須告知被納入者；(4) 深偽內容與涉及公共利益議題的 AI 生成文字須揭露。條文本身用語開放，執委會已於 7 月 20 日通過 AI Office 起草的指引填補解釋空隙，並同步發布《AI 生成內容透明度自願行為準則》，為標記與偵測義務提供一條可主張的遵循路徑。同日起，執委會對通用 AI（GPAI）模型提供者的執法權亦告生效，AI Office 可要求提供文件、直接評測模型、命令改正、限制或撤出市場，並依 Article 101 課處最高 1,500 萬歐元或全球營業額 3% 之罰鍰——對 GPAI 模型而言，主管機關是執委會本身，而非各國市場監管機關。
content.en: The AI Act's Article 50 transparency obligations have applied since August 2, 2026, across four situations: AI systems interacting directly with people must disclose that fact; providers generating synthetic audio, image, video or text must mark it in a machine-readable way; emotion-recognition and biometric-categorisation systems must inform the people subjected to them; and deepfakes and AI-generated text on matters of public interest must be disclosed. The article's language is open-ended, so on July 20 the Commission adopted the AI Office's guidelines to fill the interpretive gaps and released a voluntary Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content, giving providers a defensible route to compliance with the marking and detection duties. The same date brought the Commission's enforcement powers over general-purpose AI (GPAI) model providers into force: the AI Office can now demand documentation, evaluate models directly, order corrective measures, restrict or withdraw models from the EU market, and impose fines up to EUR 15 million or 3% of worldwide turnover under Article 101 — and for GPAI models the competent authority is the Commission itself, not the network of national market surveillance authorities.

action.zh: 盤點所有面向客戶或員工的 AI 介面（客服機器人、內部助理、行銷素材生成工具），確認互動揭露與內容標記兩件事都已落地——這是目前 AI Act 中唯一已經生效、且不需等調和標準的義務，法遵風險是即時的。採購第三方 GPAI 模型者，請在合約中要求供應商說明其是否簽署 GPAI 行為準則、以及生成內容的標記機制，因為部署者的揭露義務無法靠供應商聲明免除。
action.en: Inventory every AI interface facing customers or employees — support chatbots, internal assistants, marketing-content generators — and confirm both interaction disclosure and content marking are actually implemented. This is the only AI Act obligation currently in force that does not wait on a harmonised standard, so the compliance exposure is immediate. If you procure third-party GPAI models, require suppliers to state contractually whether they have signed the GPAI Code of Practice and how generated content is marked, because a deployer's own disclosure duty cannot be discharged by a supplier's attestation.

name.zh: EU CRA（歐盟網路韌性法案）

title.zh: 【重點追蹤】SRP 距 9/11 生效僅 12 天仍未上線，且確定不提供 API
title.en: [Watch] SRP still not live with 12 days to the September 11 deadline — and confirmed to offer no API

content.zh: 距 CRA Article 14 通報義務生效只剩 12 天，ENISA 依 Article 16 建置的單一通報平台（SRP）仍未上線。三項關鍵資訊到本期為止都還沒有：平台公開網址未公布（ENISA 表示會在上線前公布於 SRP 專頁）、被指定為協調員的各國 CSIRT 名單未公布、且**現階段不提供通報 API**。ENISA 表示功能測試與資安測試進行中，並規劃在上線前約兩週舉辦說明會。義務內容本身沒有變：自 9 月 11 日起，製造商對「已遭實際利用的漏洞」與「重大資安事件」須於知悉後 24 小時內送出早期預警、72 小時內送出完整通報；已遭利用漏洞的最終報告不得晚於矯正措施可用後 14 日，重大事件則為一個月內。ENISA 8 月 3 日的指引更新另外釐清兩點：CSIRT 驗證並非通報的前提條件（即尚未完成驗證也必須照時限通報），跨境分享目前是人工步驟。無 API 這件事的實務含意最大——它意味著 24 小時時限完全落在人工作業上。
content.en: With 12 days to the CRA Article 14 reporting obligations, the Single Reporting Platform that ENISA is building under Article 16 is still not live. Three critical pieces are outstanding as of this issue: the platform's public URL is unpublished (ENISA says it will appear on the SRP hub before go-live), the list of national CSIRTs designated as coordinators has not been released, and **no reporting API is offered at this stage**. ENISA says functional and security testing are under way and plans a webinar roughly two weeks before the platform enters service. The obligation itself is unchanged: from September 11, manufacturers must submit an early warning within 24 hours of becoming aware of an actively exploited vulnerability or a severe incident, a full notification within 72 hours, a final report no later than 14 days after a corrective measure is available for actively exploited vulnerabilities, and within one month for severe incidents. ENISA's August 3 guidance update clarified two further points: CSIRT validation is not a precondition for reporting (so an unvalidated entity must still report on time), and cross-border sharing is currently a manual step. The absence of an API carries the largest practical consequence — it places the entire 24-hour clock on human effort.

action.zh: 本週就要把通報流程定案，不要再等平台：(1) 指定 24/7 可觸及的通報負責人與代理人，並確認其在 9/11 當週的可用性；(2) 以「人工填表」為前提演練一次 24 小時流程，量測從 PSIRT 判定「已遭利用」到送出早期預警所需時間，缺口通常在內部核准層級而非填表本身；(3) 事先備妥製造商識別資料與產品清單，避免上線後才發現註冊資料不齊；(4) 指派專人追蹤 ENISA SRP 專頁，網址公布與說明會日期都會先出現在該頁。切勿因平台未上線而假設義務會延後——法規適用日並未變更。
action.en: Finalise the reporting process this week rather than waiting on the platform. First, name a 24/7 reachable reporting owner and deputy, and confirm their availability during the week of September 11. Second, rehearse the 24-hour flow assuming a manual form, measuring the time from your PSIRT declaring a vulnerability actively exploited to an early warning being submitted — the gap is usually in internal approval layers, not in filling the form. Third, prepare manufacturer identification data and the product list in advance, so registration gaps do not surface after go-live. Fourth, assign someone to watch ENISA's SRP hub, where both the URL and the webinar date will appear first. Do not assume the obligation slips because the platform has not shipped — the application date has not moved.

title.zh: 【重點追蹤】ETSI 8/13 將 17 項 CRA 產品標準送進公眾意見徵詢，OJ 仍無任何刊登
title.en: [Watch] ETSI put 17 CRA product standards into Public Enquiry on August 13; the OJ still carries none

content.zh: ETSI 於 8 月 13 日宣布，17 份為 CRA 撰寫的垂直類最終草案標準進入公眾意見徵詢（Public Enquiry），編號為 EN 304 617 至 EN 304 627 與 EN 304 631 至 EN 304 636。涵蓋的產品類別包括：瀏覽器、密碼管理器、防毒與反惡意程式、VPN、網路管理系統、SIEM、開機管理程式、PKI 與憑證簽發軟體、網路介面、作業系統、路由器／數據機／交換器、智慧家庭語音助理、智慧家庭安全產品，以及連網玩具。草案已送交歐洲 41 個會員組織（含 EEA 各國標準機構）提出意見，程序依垂直類別不同跑到 2026 年 9 月中至 11 月中。這是 CRA 標準化迄今最大一批可見進展，但必須把三個里程碑分清楚：**公眾意見徵詢 ≠ 核准為 EN ≠ 刊登歐盟公報**。截至本期，OJ 尚未刊登任何 CRA 調和標準，Article 27 的合規推定對所有產品類別都還不可用。
content.en: On August 13, ETSI announced that 17 vertical final draft standards written for the CRA had entered Public Enquiry, numbered EN 304 617 to EN 304 627 and EN 304 631 to EN 304 636. The product categories covered are browsers, password managers, antivirus and antimalware, VPNs, network management systems, SIEM systems, boot managers, PKI and certificate-issuance software, network interfaces, operating systems, routers/modems/switches, smart-home virtual assistants, smart-home security products, and internet-connected toys. The drafts went to 41 member organisations across Europe, including the EEA's national standards bodies, and the procedure runs from mid-September to mid-November 2026 depending on the vertical. This is the largest visible batch of CRA standardisation progress so far, but three milestones must be kept apart: **Public Enquiry is not approval as an EN, and approval is not citation in the Official Journal.** As of this issue no CRA harmonised standard has been cited in the OJ, so the Article 27 presumption of conformity is unavailable for every product category.

action.zh: 先確認貴司產品是否落在這 17 個垂直類別中——若是，草案文本現在就可取得，應立即做技術要求的差距分析，並評估是否透過所屬國家標準機構提出意見（意見徵詢是唯一能影響最終條文的窗口，錯過就只能接受結果）。不在這 17 類的產品仍受 CRA 的必要要求（Annex I）拘束，只是缺乏產品類別專屬標準，需自行以技術文件論證符合性。無論哪一類，都不要把「刊登 OJ」當成準備工作的起點。
action.en: First determine whether your products fall within these 17 verticals. If they do, the draft texts are available now: run a gap analysis against the technical requirements immediately and decide whether to comment through your national standards body — the enquiry is the only window in which the final text can still be influenced, and once it closes you simply live with the result. Products outside the 17 categories remain bound by the CRA's essential requirements in Annex I; they merely lack a category-specific standard and must argue conformity through their own technical documentation. Either way, do not treat OJ citation as the starting gun for preparation.

title.zh: 執委會擬修訂標準化委託 M/606，2026 年標準交付期限整體延後兩個月
title.en: The Commission has drafted an amendment to standardisation request M/606, slipping the 2026 delivery deadlines by two months

content.zh: 執委會於 7 月初公布標準化委託 M/606 的修訂草案，把 CRA 調和標準在 2026 年的起草交付期限往後推兩個月。原委託（2025 年初發給 CEN、CENELEC 與 ETSI）要求橫向 A 類標準與漏洞管理 B 類標準於 2026 年 8 月 30 日前交付、產品專屬 C 類標準於 2026 年 10 月 30 日前交付；修訂草案將 A 類與 B 類移至 2026 年 10 月 31 日、C 類移至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。要特別留意兩件事：第一，**法規本身的義務內容與適用日一天都沒有改變**——通報義務仍為 2026 年 9 月 11 日，主要義務仍為 2027 年 12 月 11 日；第二，交付只是流程的起點，標準要能主張 Article 27 合規推定，還須經執委會評估與正式刊登 OJ 決定，這中間通常再耗數月。實務上這代表：即使 C 類標準如期在年底交付，2027 年上半年才可能出現首批可用的合規推定，距 2027/12/11 只剩不到一年。
content.en: In early July the Commission published a draft amendment to standardisation request M/606, pushing the 2026 drafting-delivery deadlines for CRA harmonised standards back by two months. The original request, issued to CEN, CENELEC and ETSI in early 2025, required the horizontal Type A standards and the Type B vulnerability-management standards by August 30, 2026, and the product-specific Type C standards by October 30, 2026. The draft amendment moves A and B to October 31, 2026 and C to December 31, 2026. Two points deserve emphasis. First, **nothing in the regulation's obligations or application dates has moved** — reporting still starts September 11, 2026, and the main obligations still apply from December 11, 2027. Second, delivery is only the start of the process: before a standard confers the Article 27 presumption it must still pass Commission assessment and a formal OJ citation decision, which typically consumes several more months. Practically, that means even if the Type C standards land on time at year-end, the first usable presumptions of conformity are unlikely before the first half of 2027 — leaving under a year to December 11, 2027.

action.zh: 把合規路徑的規劃假設改成「沒有調和標準也要能出貨」：以 CRA Annex I 必要要求為基準自行建立技術文件與風險評鑑，並在需要技術依據時引用既有的成熟標準（工控產品用 IEC 62443-4-1／4-2，一般產品可參考 EN 18031 系列與 ISO/IEC 27034）。同時把「標準延後」寫進管理層報告的風險項——這不是好消息，它壓縮的是刊登後到義務日之間的緩衝，而非放寬義務。
action.en: Reset your compliance-path assumption to "ship without a harmonised standard." Build technical documentation and risk assessment directly against the CRA's Annex I essential requirements, citing established standards where a technical basis is needed (IEC 62443-4-1/4-2 for industrial products; the EN 18031 series and ISO/IEC 27034 as references for general products). Also record the standards slip as a risk item in management reporting — this is not good news: it compresses the buffer between citation and the obligation date rather than relaxing the obligation.

name.zh: EU NIS2（歐盟網路與資訊安全指令 2.0）

title.zh: 【重點追蹤】四國訴訟案：本期 CJEU 無公開程序進展，三國轉換時程仍不明
title.en: [Watch] Four-country case: no public CJEU procedural progress this period; three states' timelines remain unclear

content.zh: 本期查無新的 CJEU 程序公開資訊——案件登錄、言詞辯論日期、佐審官意見均未見公布，執委會亦未公告撤回對荷蘭的案件。三國轉換進度：愛爾蘭表示預期在 2026 年底前完成通知；西班牙尚無 NIS2 法律生效，預期落在 2026 年底、法案迄今未刊登於官方公報（BOE）；法國仍未公布明確時程，是四國中進度最落後者。荷蘭則已於 8 月 15 日讓 Cyberbeveiligingswet 生效，是否撤案取決於是否已向執委會完成「正式通知轉換」。由於執委會請求的是一次性罰款加按日計罰、計至各國完成通知為止，愛爾蘭、西班牙、法國每多拖一週，潛在罰額就持續累積。需提醒的是，訴訟針對的是成員國而非企業，但指令的實質要求並不因本國法未到位而對企業失效——在這三國營運的組織仍處於「義務存在、但監管機關與登記機制尚未成形」的空窗狀態。
content.en: No new public CJEU procedural information surfaced this period: no case registration details, hearing date or Advocate General opinion, and no Commission announcement withdrawing the case against the Netherlands. On transposition, Ireland has signalled it expects to notify by the end of 2026; Spain has no NIS2 law in force, expects late 2026, and its bill has still not appeared in the official gazette (BOE); France has published no firm timeline and remains the furthest behind of the four. The Netherlands brought its Cyberbeveiligingswet into force on August 15, so withdrawal turns on whether it has completed formal notification of transposition to the Commission. Because the Commission is seeking a lump sum plus daily penalties running until notification, every additional week adds to the exposure of Ireland, Spain and France. Note that the action targets member states, not companies — but the directive's substantive requirements do not lapse for companies just because national law is missing. Organisations operating in those three states sit in a gap where the obligations exist while the supervisory authority and registration machinery do not.

action.zh: 在愛爾蘭、西班牙、法國有據點者，不要等本國立法：以指令本文 Article 21（風險管理措施）與 Article 23（事件通報）自評，並參考 NIS Cooperation Group 的 Article 21 參考文件建立控制清單；本國法一旦公布，登記期限通常只有數週到數月，事前備妥實體分類（essential／important）判定依據與聯絡窗口資料，可避免屆時倉促。撤案、判決或任一國完成立法，本站將以高度關注回報。
action.en: If you have entities in Ireland, Spain or France, do not wait for national law: self-assess against Articles 21 (risk-management measures) and 23 (incident reporting) of the directive itself, and build your control list against the NIS Cooperation Group's Article 21 reference document. Once a national law does appear, registration windows are typically only weeks to months, so preparing your essential/important classification rationale and contact data in advance avoids a scramble. A withdrawal, a judgment, or any of the three completing transposition will be reported here as a priority.

title.zh: 【續報】荷蘭 Cbw 登記已轉為強制：逾 8,000 家在範圍內、需 eHerkenning EH3、無寬限期
title.en: [Follow-up] Dutch Cbw registration is now mandatory: 8,000+ entities in scope, eHerkenning EH3 required, no grace period

content.zh: 上期已報導荷蘭 Cyberbeveiligingswet（Cbw）於 8 月 15 日生效，本期補上實際操作細節。8 月 15 日之前，必要實體、重要實體與網域註冊服務提供者可自願向國家網路安全中心（NCSC）登記；**自該日起登記轉為強制**。荷蘭官方估計超過 8,000 家組織落入適用範圍。登記須透過 Mijn.NCSC.nl 進行，並需具備 eHerkenning 等級 EH3 或以上的身分驗證憑證。關鍵在於：**沒有一般性的寬限期**——登記、照護義務（duty of care）與事件通報義務全部自生效日起同步適用，不存在「先登記、義務稍後」的緩衝。對製造業供應鏈而言，這件事的意義不只在荷蘭子公司本身：荷蘭客戶一旦進入 NIS2 監管，其供應鏈安全條款（Article 21(2)(d)）的稽核與合約要求會直接傳導到上游供應商。
content.en: Last issue reported that the Dutch Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw) entered into force on August 15; this issue adds the operational detail. Before August 15, essential entities, important entities and domain-name registration service providers could register with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) voluntarily; **from that date registration became mandatory.** Dutch authorities estimate more than 8,000 organisations fall in scope. Registration runs through Mijn.NCSC.nl and requires an eHerkenning credential at level EH3 or higher. The critical point: **there is no general grace period** — registration, the duty of care and incident reporting all apply from day one, with no "register now, comply later" buffer. For manufacturing supply chains the significance extends beyond Dutch subsidiaries themselves: once Dutch customers fall under NIS2 supervision, the audit and contractual requirements flowing from the supply-chain security provision (Article 21(2)(d)) pass straight up to their suppliers.

action.zh: 在荷蘭設有法人或提供服務者，本週確認三件事：(1) 是否已完成 Mijn.NCSC.nl 登記，若尚未，先確認 eHerkenning EH3 憑證已申請（憑證核發本身需作業時間，常是實際卡關點）；(2) 事件通報流程是否已對接 NCSC 的時限要求；(3) 照護義務所要求的風險管理措施是否有可稽核的文件證據。同時提醒業務與採購單位：荷蘭客戶的供應鏈安全問卷與合約條款預期在未來一至兩季明顯增加，宜提前備妥 ISO 27001 證書、SBOM 與漏洞揭露政策等標準回覆素材。
action.en: If you have a Dutch legal entity or provide services there, confirm three things this week. First, whether Mijn.NCSC.nl registration is complete — and if not, whether the eHerkenning EH3 credential has been applied for, since issuance takes time and is the usual bottleneck. Second, whether your incident-reporting process is wired to the NCSC's deadlines. Third, whether the risk-management measures required by the duty of care are backed by auditable documentary evidence. Also warn sales and procurement: supply-chain security questionnaires and contract clauses from Dutch customers should increase noticeably over the next one to two quarters, so prepare standard response material — ISO 27001 certificates, SBOMs, vulnerability disclosure policy — in advance.

name.zh: CMMC（美國國防部網路安全成熟度模型認證）

title.zh: 【重點追蹤】改革小組報告倒數兩週：9/13 前後送交，Phase 1 義務全數維持有效
title.en: [Watch] Two weeks to the reform task force report, due around September 13; all Phase 1 obligations remain in force

content.zh: 本期無新的官方公告。時程確認如下：DoD 於 7 月 13 日發布兩份備忘錄，立即暫停 CMMC 後續實施期限（含原訂 2026 年 11 月 10 日進入 Phase 2），並成立 60 天改革小組；意見徵詢（RFI）已於 8 月 14 日截止，蒐集業界對合規成本驅動因素、行政負擔、控制措施與實際成效對應、商用解決方案可用性及具體政策改革建議的回饋；改革小組須於 60 天內向 DoW CIO 提交建議，即 9 月 13 日前後（部分分析認為實際公開時間可能落在 9 月中至 10 月初）。必須反覆強調的是：**這是政策暫停，不是廢止**。Phase 1 自評、SPRS 分數維護與年度確認、NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 實作、以及 DFARS 252.204-7012 的保護與通報義務全部維持完全有效，違反這些仍構成合約違約風險。暫停的只有第三方評鑑（C3PAO）強制化的時程。
content.en: No new official announcement this period. The timeline stands as follows. On July 13 the DoD issued two memoranda immediately suspending upcoming CMMC implementation deadlines, including the planned November 10, 2026 move to Phase 2, and standing up a 60-day reform task force. The Request for Information closed on August 14, gathering industry input on compliance cost drivers, administrative burden, which controls map to tangible outcomes, availability of commercial solutions, and concrete policy reform recommendations. The task force must deliver its recommendations to the DoW CIO within 60 days — on or about September 13, though some analyses expect public release between mid-September and early October. It bears repeating: **this is a policy pause, not a repeal.** Phase 1 self-assessments, SPRS score maintenance and annual affirmations, NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 implementation, and the safeguarding and reporting duties of DFARS 252.204-7012 all remain fully in force, and failing them still carries contract-breach risk. Only the timeline for mandatory third-party (C3PAO) assessment is suspended.

action.zh: 持有或競標美國國防合約者，這兩週不要停下 800-171 的實作與 SPRS 分數維護——暫停的是評鑑時程，不是控制要求，而報告出爐後若恢復時程，落後的差距只會更難補。已排定 C3PAO 評鑑者，建議與評鑑機構確認排程與費用在政策明朗前如何處理，避免預付款項卡在暫停期。報告發布當期本站將以高度關注回報，重點看四件事：C3PAO 認證是恢復、取代或分級化；Level 2／Level 3 要求是否鬆綁；是否啟動 DFARS 或 32 CFR 修訂程序；Phase 2 是否給出新的生效日。
action.en: If you hold or bid on US defense contracts, do not pause your 800-171 implementation or SPRS score maintenance over the next two weeks — what is suspended is the assessment timeline, not the control requirements, and if the report restores a schedule, a widened gap only gets harder to close. If a C3PAO assessment is already booked, confirm with the assessment body how scheduling and fees will be handled until the policy clears, so prepayments are not stranded through the pause. We will report the release as a priority, watching four things: whether C3PAO certification is restored, replaced or tiered; whether Level 2 and Level 3 requirements are relaxed; whether a DFARS or 32 CFR rulemaking is initiated; and whether Phase 2 gets a new effective date.

name.zh: ISO 27000 系列（資訊安全標準）

title.zh: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 發布：睽違 11 年改版，雲端專屬控制由 7 項精簡為 4 項並全面對齊 27002:2022
title.en: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 published: the first revision in eleven years cuts cloud-specific controls from seven to four and realigns to 27002:2022

content.zh: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 已發布為第二版，取代 2015 年初版，是該標準十一年來首次改版。核心變動是結構性的：初版採用 ISO/IEC 27002:2013 的章節架構並額外定義 7 項雲端專屬（CLD）控制措施；2026 年版改採 ISO/IEC 27002:2022 的四大類（組織、人員、實體、技術）結構，僅保留 4 項獨立的雲端專屬控制，其餘原本以 CLD 形式單列的主題，改為併入對應的 27002:2022 控制之內以附加指引方式處理。歐洲同步採認為 EN ISO/IEC 27017:2026。實務含意有兩層：對已依 27002:2022 重整控制清單的組織，27017 的導入與對應工作明顯變簡單，不必再維護兩套編號體系；但對現行以 27017:2015 的 CLD 編號撰寫雲端控制矩陣、供應商問卷或客戶稽核回覆的組織，這些文件的編號對應會全面失效，需要重新映射。此外提醒，27017 是指引性標準（guidance），本身不提供可驗證的認證，其價值在於作為 ISMS 範圍內雲端控制的實作依據與稽核佐證。
content.en: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 has been published as the second edition, replacing the 2015 original — the standard's first revision in eleven years. The core change is structural. The first edition followed the clause architecture of ISO/IEC 27002:2013 and added seven cloud-specific (CLD) controls; the 2026 edition adopts the four-theme structure of ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (organisational, people, physical, technological) and retains only four standalone cloud-specific controls, folding the remaining topics that were previously separate CLD entries into the corresponding 27002:2022 controls as additional guidance. Europe has adopted it in parallel as EN ISO/IEC 27017:2026. There are two practical consequences. For organisations that have already restructured their control set onto 27002:2022, implementing and mapping 27017 becomes markedly simpler, with no need to maintain two numbering schemes. But for those whose cloud control matrices, supplier questionnaires or customer audit responses are written against 27017:2015 CLD numbers, that numbering correspondence breaks entirely and must be re-mapped. Note also that 27017 is a guidance standard offering no certifiable requirements of its own; its value lies in underpinning and evidencing cloud controls within an ISMS scope.

action.zh: 使用公有雲或提供雲端服務者，安排一次映射作業：把現行雲端控制矩陣由 27017:2015 的 CLD 編號改對應 27017:2026 與 27002:2022，優先處理對外文件（客戶稽核回覆、供應商安全問卷、雲端服務合約附件），因為這些一旦編號失效最容易在稽核現場被質疑。同時通知內部稽核與資安治理單位更新查檢表。若貴司同時受 CRA 或 NIS2 供應鏈條款拘束，這次改版是把雲端控制證據一次整理到位的好時機——兩者的稽核都會問到雲端環境的責任分界與控制實作。
action.en: If you use public cloud or provide cloud services, schedule a mapping exercise: move your cloud control matrix from 27017:2015 CLD numbering onto 27017:2026 and 27002:2022, prioritising outward-facing documents — customer audit responses, supplier security questionnaires, cloud contract annexes — since broken numbering in those is what gets challenged during an audit. Tell internal audit and security governance to refresh their checklists. If you are also subject to CRA or NIS2 supply-chain provisions, this revision is a good moment to consolidate cloud control evidence in one pass, as both regimes' audits ask about responsibility boundaries and control implementation in cloud environments.

title.zh: 【背景補充】ISO/IEC 42006 才是決定 42001 證書可信度的那份標準
title.en: [Background] ISO/IEC 42006 is the standard that actually determines whether an ISO 42001 certificate means anything

date.zh: 42006:2025 已發布，各國認可方案於 2026 年陸續上線
date.en: 42006:2025 published; national accreditation programmes rolling out through 2026

content.zh: 隨著 ISO/IEC 42001 證書在供應鏈問卷與標案中出現得愈來愈頻繁，值得補充一個常被忽略的環節：證書的可信度不是由 42001 本身決定，而是由 ISO/IEC 42006 決定。42006 規定「執行 AIMS 稽核與驗證的機構」須具備的額外要求，建構於 ISO/IEC 17021-1 之上，涵蓋稽核員能力、稽核工時、驗證範圍界定等——換言之，它是驗證機構的驗證標準。該標準已發布為 ISO/IEC 42006:2025，並陸續被各國採認（例如 SIST ISO/IEC 42006:2026）。認可機構（如美國 ANAB）據此建立 ISO/IEC 42001 驗證機構的認可方案，2026 年間陸續上線。實務上的分辨方式很簡單：一張由「已取得認可（accredited）之驗證機構」簽發的 42001 證書，與一張由未經認可機構簽發的證書，在稽核與採購審查中的份量差距很大，而供應鏈問卷通常不會替你分辨。另需提醒：ISO 42001 至今**不是** EU AI Act 的調和標準，取得認證不產生任何合規推定效果。
content.en: As ISO/IEC 42001 certificates turn up more often in supply-chain questionnaires and tenders, one frequently overlooked link is worth spelling out: a certificate's credibility is determined not by 42001 itself but by ISO/IEC 42006. That standard sets the additional requirements for bodies performing AIMS audit and certification, building on ISO/IEC 17021-1 and covering auditor competence, audit duration and scope definition — in other words, it is the standard against which certification bodies themselves are assessed. It has been published as ISO/IEC 42006:2025 and is being adopted nationally (for example SIST ISO/IEC 42006:2026). Accreditation bodies such as ANAB in the United States are using it to build accreditation programmes for ISO/IEC 42001 certification bodies, which are coming online through 2026. The practical distinction is simple: a 42001 certificate issued by an accredited certification body carries substantially more weight in audits and procurement review than one issued by an unaccredited body — and supply-chain questionnaires usually will not make that distinction for you. Note also that ISO 42001 is still **not** a harmonised standard under the EU AI Act, so certification confers no presumption of conformity.

action.zh: 若貴司規劃導入 ISO 42001，選擇驗證機構時明確確認其是否已取得 42006 為基礎的認可（可向該國認可機構查證，而非僅信任機構自述）。若貴司是在審查供應商，把「驗證機構名稱與認可機構」列入問卷欄位，而非只收一張證書 PDF。同時在對外溝通中避免把 42001 認證與 AI Act 合規劃上等號——那會在客戶法務審查時造成不必要的爭議。
action.en: If you are planning an ISO 42001 implementation, verify explicitly that your chosen certification body holds accreditation based on 42006 — check with that country's accreditation body rather than relying on the certifier's own claim. If you are the one reviewing suppliers, add fields for the certification body's name and its accreditation body to your questionnaire instead of accepting a certificate PDF alone. And avoid equating 42001 certification with AI Act compliance in external communications; that creates avoidable friction in customers' legal reviews.

title.zh: 【續報】ISA 2027 內容細節公開：46 項控制中 44 項改寫、多項要求由 should 升格為 must
title.en: [Follow-up] ISA 2027 detail emerges: 44 of 46 controls rewritten, with requirements promoted from should to must

content.zh: 上期已報導 VDA ISA 2027 自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起對新開案的 TISAX 評鑑強制適用、且版本編號改為年份制（取代 ISA 6.0／6.0.3 的舊編號）並改採年度發布週期。本期補上內容差異：資訊安全模組的控制數量維持 46 項不變，但其中 **44 項有文字修訂**，25 項的要求內容出現實質變動（新增、刪除或移位）。變動的主要模式是**要求層級上調**——原本屬「應該（should）」層級的要求被改列為「必須（must）」，例如控制 1.1.1 關於資安政策與員工溝通的部分。原型保護模組則由 22 項縮減為 20 項並完成整體重構。時程上，在 ENX 另行公告前，現行進行中的評鑑仍依 ISA 6 執行，既有的 TISAX 標章不會因改版自動失效。要注意的是「維持 46 項」這個數字容易造成誤判——控制數量沒變不代表工作量沒變，實際落差來自 should 升 must 的部分，那些原本可以用「已評估、暫不實施」帶過的項目，改版後將成為不符合事項。
content.en: Last issue reported that VDA ISA 2027 becomes mandatory for newly ordered TISAX assessments from January 1, 2027, that version numbering moves to a year-based scheme (replacing ISA 6.0 / 6.0.3), and that publication shifts to an annual cycle. This issue adds the content delta. The information security module keeps 46 controls, but **44 of them have been edited**, and 25 carry substantive changes to their requirements — added, removed or relocated. The dominant pattern is an **escalation of requirement level**: items previously at "should" have been moved to "must", for instance in control 1.1.1 covering security policy and employee communication. The prototype protection module shrinks from 22 controls to 20 and has been restructured throughout. On timing, assessments already under way continue on ISA 6 until ENX announces otherwise, and existing TISAX labels do not lapse automatically because of the revision. Be careful with the "still 46 controls" figure — an unchanged control count does not mean unchanged effort. The real delta sits in the should-to-must promotions: items you could previously close out as "assessed, not implemented for now" become non-conformities after the revision.

action.zh: 有 TISAX 標章或計畫申請者，現在就做一件事：把現行 ISA 6 自評結果中所有標記為「should 但未實施」或「部分實施」的控制項拉出清單，這批就是 2027 版最可能變成不符合事項的候選。若標章到期日落在 2027 年且需重新評鑑，實質準備期只剩約四個月，建議把差距補實的工作排進 Q4 而非等到明年。原型保護標章持有者另須留意模組重構後的對應關係，宜與稽核機構先確認新舊控制的映射。
action.en: If you hold a TISAX label or plan to apply, do one thing now: pull a list of every control in your current ISA 6 self-assessment marked "should, not implemented" or "partially implemented." That set is the most likely source of non-conformities under the 2027 catalogue. If your label expires during 2027 and requires reassessment, the substantive runway is roughly four months, so schedule the remediation into Q4 rather than deferring to next year. Holders of prototype protection labels should additionally confirm the old-to-new control mapping with their audit provider given the module restructuring.

name.zh: IEC 62443（工控與 OT 資安標準）

title.zh: CISA 8/27 一次發布 7 則 ICS 建議通報，含三菱電機多項 FA 產品
title.en: CISA issued seven ICS advisories on August 27, including multiple Mitsubishi Electric FA products

content.zh: CISA 於 8 月 27 日一次發布 7 則工業控制系統（ICS）建議通報（編號 ICSA-26-239-01 起），涵蓋多個產業別使用的產品，其中包含三菱電機多項工廠自動化（FA）產品，以及 Applied Systems Engineering ASE2000 V2 通訊測試儀。以 ICSA-26-239-01（Xiiaozet LK100W）為例，該產品的網頁式管理介面存在作業系統命令注入漏洞，影響 LK100W 2.1.240 以前版本，已通過驗證的攻擊者可以提升後的權限執行任意作業系統命令，可能導致敏感資訊外洩或裝置完全淪陷。本期無新的 IEC 62443 標準改版或 ISASecure 方案公告。從 IEC 62443 的角度看，這批通報反覆指向同一組基本控制的落實程度：62443-4-2 的元件要求（CR 1.x 識別與鑑別、CR 2.x 使用控制）與 62443-3-3 的系統要求（SR 5.1 網路分割），而網頁管理介面上的命令注入之所以能造成完整淪陷，往往正是因為該介面本不該從一般網段直接可達。
content.en: On August 27 CISA released seven Industrial Control Systems advisories in a single batch (beginning with ICSA-26-239-01), covering products used across multiple sectors, among them several Mitsubishi Electric factory automation (FA) products and the Applied Systems Engineering ASE2000 V2 Communications Test Set. Taking ICSA-26-239-01 (Xiiaozet LK100W) as an example, its web-based management interface carries an OS command injection flaw affecting versions before LK100W 2.1.240; an authenticated attacker may execute arbitrary operating system commands with elevated privileges, potentially leading to disclosure of sensitive information or full device compromise. There were no new IEC 62443 standard revisions or ISASecure scheme announcements this period. Viewed through IEC 62443, this batch keeps pointing at the same set of basic controls: the component requirements of 62443-4-2 (CR 1.x identification and authentication, CR 2.x use control) and the system requirements of 62443-3-3 (SR 5.1 network segmentation). Command injection on a web management interface escalates to full compromise largely because that interface should not have been directly reachable from a general network segment in the first place.

action.zh: OT 資安負責人本週檢視三件事：(1) 比對 8/27 這批通報的受影響產品清單與廠內資產清冊，三菱電機 FA 產品在製造現場普遍存在，優先確認版本；(2) 針對無法立即更新韌體的設備（產線停機成本高，這是常態），以補償控制處理——限制管理介面僅由跳板機存取、關閉不需要的網頁管理服務、於區段邊界加上存取控制清單；(3) 若貴司同時是工控產品的製造商，這類通報正是 CRA 生效後的通報素材型態，建議以此為例演練一次 SRP 的 24 小時流程判定：什麼情況算「已遭實際利用」、由誰決定、多久能決定。
action.en: OT security owners should check three things this week. First, cross-reference the affected product list from the August 27 batch against your plant asset inventory — Mitsubishi Electric FA products are widespread on manufacturing floors, so confirm versions first. Second, for equipment that cannot be patched immediately (line downtime cost makes this the norm), apply compensating controls: restrict management interfaces to jump-host access, disable unneeded web management services, and add access control lists at segment boundaries. Third, if you also manufacture industrial products, advisories like these are exactly the material that will drive reporting once the CRA applies — use this batch to rehearse the SRP 24-hour decision: what counts as "actively exploited", who decides, and how fast that decision can be made.

title.zh: Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 遭實際利用：原列 DoS，PoC 公布後證實可達免認證 RCE
title.en: Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 exploited in the wild: rated a DoS, but shown to allow unauthenticated RCE after a PoC dropped

content.zh: CISA 於 8 月 26 日將 Citrix NetScaler ADC 與 NetScaler Gateway 的 CVE-2026-8452 列入已遭利用漏洞（KEV）目錄，並要求聯邦機關於 8 月 29 日前完成修補——三天的修補期限反映其判定的急迫性。這個案例值得所有資安主管注意的是嚴重性判定的落差：Citrix 於 2026 年 6 月 30 日揭露並同日釋出修補（14.1-72.61、13.1-63.18、13.1-37.272），官方公告將其描述為可導致行為異常與阻斷服務（DoS）的記憶體溢位漏洞；但 watchTowr Labs 於 8 月 14 日公布技術分析與可運作的概念驗證程式碼，證實該漏洞可被利用達成**免認證遠端程式碼執行**。PoC 公開後不久即出現實際攻擊，資安廠商觀察到攻擊者藉此投放 web shell。受影響條件為設備配置為 Gateway（SSL VPN、ICA Proxy、CVPN、RDP Proxy）或 AAA 虛擬伺服器。這是今年第二次在本站報導 SSL VPN 類設備遭利用（上月為 Cisco ASA/FTD），模式一致：網際網路可達的遠端存取閘道，一旦有 PoC 就會在數日內被大規模掃描。
content.en: On August 26 CISA added CVE-2026-8452 in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, directing federal agencies to remediate by August 29 — a three-day window that reflects how urgent it judged the situation. What makes this case worth every security leader's attention is the severity gap. Citrix disclosed the issue on June 30, 2026, shipping patches the same day (14.1-72.61, 13.1-63.18, 13.1-37.272) and describing it in its advisory as a memory-overflow flaw leading to unpredictable or erroneous behaviour and denial of service. But on August 14 watchTowr Labs published a technical writeup together with working proof-of-concept code demonstrating that the flaw can be exploited for **unauthenticated remote code execution**. Real attacks followed shortly after the PoC went public, with security firms observing attackers using it to drop web shells. Exploitation requires the appliance to be configured as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or as an AAA virtual server. This is the second time this year we have reported exploitation of an SSL VPN-class appliance (Cisco ASA/FTD last month), and the pattern is identical: internet-reachable remote access gateways get mass-scanned within days of a PoC appearing.

action.zh: 立即清點所有 NetScaler ADC／Gateway 設備並確認版本是否已達 14.1-72.61、13.1-63.18 或 13.1-37.272 以上；由於修補已釋出兩個月，重點不是「有沒有修補程式」，而是「6 月 30 日那批修補當時是否被當成 DoS 而降級處理、因而延後或跳過」。已修補者仍應進行入侵跡證檢視（web shell、異常設定變更、管理帳號新增），因為攻擊窗口從 8 月中就已開啟。制度面的教訓更重要：把「廠商評定為 DoS」的漏洞自動歸為低優先，是這次事件的根本成因；建議把「網際網路可達的遠端存取設備」設為例外類別，不論廠商評級一律於短期內修補。
action.en: Inventory every NetScaler ADC/Gateway appliance immediately and confirm versions are at or above 14.1-72.61, 13.1-63.18 or 13.1-37.272. Since the patch has been out for two months, the question is not whether a fix exists but whether the June 30 batch was deprioritised or skipped because it was classed as a DoS issue. Even if patched, hunt for indicators of compromise — web shells, unexpected configuration changes, newly added admin accounts — because the exploitation window opened in mid-August. The systemic lesson matters more: automatically treating vendor-rated DoS bugs as low priority is the root cause here. Make internet-reachable remote access appliances an exception class, patched on a short clock regardless of the vendor's severity rating.

title.zh: CISA 本週三度更新 KEV 共新增 10 項，JFrog Artifactory 路徑穿越直擊軟體供應鏈
title.en: CISA updated the KEV catalog three times this week, adding ten entries — including a JFrog Artifactory path traversal hitting the software supply chain

content.zh: CISA 本週連續三個工作日更新已遭利用漏洞目錄，合計新增 10 項：8 月 25 日新增 1 項（CVE-2026-60004，Gitea 程式碼注入）；8 月 26 日新增 6 項（CVE-2015-3246 Red Hat Libuser 競爭條件、CVE-2015-5287 Red Hat ABRT 權限提升、CVE-2019-1068 Microsoft SQL Server 遠端程式碼執行、CVE-2021-23758 Ajax.NET Professional 不安全反序列化、CVE-2022-0995 Linux Kernel 越界寫入，以及前述 Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452）；8 月 27 日再新增 3 項（CVE-2023-49105 ownCloud 身分驗證缺陷、CVE-2026-53362 Linux Kernel 漏洞、CVE-2026-66384 JFrog Artifactory 路徑穿越），修補期限訂於 9 月 10 日。其中最值得製造業與研發單位注意的是 JFrog Artifactory：CVE-2026-66384 是 Docker 快取處理的路徑穿越漏洞（CWE-22，CVSS 5.3），已通過驗證的使用者可在特定遠端儲存庫條件下把資料寫到預期的 Docker 快取路徑之外；影響 7.146.35 之前版本與 7.161.0 至 7.161.16，自架環境須升級至 7.146.35 或 7.161.16。CVSS 只有 5.3 卻已遭實際利用，正說明分數不等於風險——Artifactory 是建置產出物的儲存庫，能寫入非預期路徑意味著能污染下游所有取用該產出物的建置流程。另一個模式值得注意：本週新增的 10 項中有 5 項是 2015 至 2022 年的舊漏洞，攻擊者正在系統性地掃描長期未修補的資產。
content.en: CISA updated the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on three consecutive business days this week, adding ten entries in total. August 25 brought one (CVE-2026-60004, Gitea code injection). August 26 brought six (CVE-2015-3246 Red Hat Libuser race condition, CVE-2015-5287 Red Hat ABRT privilege escalation, CVE-2019-1068 Microsoft SQL Server remote code execution, CVE-2021-23758 Ajax.NET Professional insecure deserialization, CVE-2022-0995 Linux kernel out-of-bounds write, plus the Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 above). August 27 brought three (CVE-2023-49105 ownCloud improper authentication, CVE-2026-53362 Linux kernel, and CVE-2026-66384 JFrog Artifactory path traversal), with a September 10 remediation date. The entry manufacturing and R&D organisations should look at hardest is JFrog Artifactory: CVE-2026-66384 is a path-traversal flaw in Docker cache handling (CWE-22, CVSS 5.3) letting an authenticated user write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions. It affects versions before 7.146.35 and 7.161.0 through 7.161.16; self-hosted instances must move to 7.146.35 or 7.161.16. A CVSS of just 5.3 that is nonetheless being exploited illustrates that a score is not a risk assessment — Artifactory holds build artifacts, so writing outside the expected path means poisoning every downstream build that consumes them. One further pattern is worth noting: five of the ten additions this week are vulnerabilities from 2015 to 2022, evidence that attackers are systematically sweeping for long-unpatched assets.

action.zh: 研發與 DevOps 單位本週處理兩件事：(1) 確認自架 JFrog Artifactory 版本並排定升級，同時檢視遠端儲存庫（remote repository）設定是否符合觸發條件，以及 Docker 快取目錄是否有非預期檔案；由於這牽涉建置產出物完整性，建議一併檢視近期建置產物的雜湊值。(2) 針對本週入列的五項舊漏洞（2015–2022），以資產清冊比對而非僅依賴弱點掃描結果——這類長年未修補的系統往往正是掃描器涵蓋不到的邊緣資產（測試機、停用但未下架的服務、外包廠商代管環境）。另建議把 KEV 目錄納入例行流程：它是唯一以「已遭實際利用」為納入標準的公開清單，優先序價值高於 CVSS 分數。
action.en: Development and DevOps should handle two things this week. First, confirm your self-hosted JFrog Artifactory version and schedule the upgrade, while reviewing whether remote repository configuration matches the triggering conditions and whether the Docker cache directory holds unexpected files; because build-artifact integrity is at stake, also review hashes of recently produced artifacts. Second, address the five older vulnerabilities (2015–2022) added this week by cross-referencing your asset inventory rather than relying on scanner output alone — systems unpatched for that long are typically the edge assets scanners miss: test machines, decommissioned-but-not-removed services, outsourced hosting environments. It is also worth building the KEV catalog into routine process: it is the only public list whose inclusion criterion is actual exploitation, which makes it more valuable for prioritisation than a CVSS score.

title.zh: 美國 ATF 確認遭 Qilin 勒索攻擊，司法部認定為「重大事件」
title.en: The US ATF confirms a Qilin ransomware breach; the Justice Department declares it a "major incident"

content.zh: 美國菸酒槍炮及爆裂物管理局（ATF）於 8 月 27 日確認其一套電腦系統遭入侵，此前俄羅斯關聯的勒索軟體集團 Qilin 已在暗網外洩網站上列出該機構。據報導，遭入侵的系統存放 ATF 刑事調查對象的資訊，但該機構表示該系統為與主要企業網路隔離的獨立環境，目前無跡象顯示 ATF 企業網路、eForms 系統或其他系統受到影響。司法部資深官員依聯邦準則將此事件認定為「重大事件（major incident）」——這是有法律定義的正式分級，會觸發向國會議員的正式通報程序。產業追蹤顯示 Qilin 今年大幅升高對美國目標的攻擊，2026 年已宣稱攻擊約 40 家美國企業，其中包含四家財星 500 大公司。此事件對一般企業的參考價值在於「隔離環境」這個說法：ATF 強調受害系統與企業網路隔離，這確實限制了損害範圍，但也提醒一件事——隔離環境往往因為「反正是隔離的」而在修補、監控與存取管理上被降級對待，反而成為最容易被打穿的一環。
content.en: The US Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives confirmed on August 27 that one of its computer systems had been breached, after the Russia-linked ransomware group Qilin listed the agency on its dark web leak site. The compromised system reportedly held information on subjects of ATF criminal investigations, though the bureau says it was an isolated environment separated from its main enterprise network, with no indication that the ATF enterprise network, the eForms system or any other system was affected. Senior Justice Department officials classified the breach as a "major incident" under federal guidelines — a formal, legally defined designation that triggers notification to members of Congress. Industry tracking shows Qilin has sharply escalated its US targeting this year, claiming attacks on roughly 40 American businesses in 2026, four of them Fortune 500 companies. The value of this case for ordinary enterprises lies in the phrase "isolated environment": ATF stresses that the affected system was separated from the enterprise network, which genuinely limited the blast radius — but it is also a reminder that isolated environments are frequently deprioritised for patching, monitoring and access management precisely because they are isolated, which is what makes them the easiest segment to break.

action.zh: 盤點貴司被歸類為「隔離」或「獨立」的環境——研發實驗網段、產線離線系統、併購後尚未整併的子公司網路、外包廠商代管的專案環境——確認它們是否確實納入弱點管理、日誌蒐集與存取覆核的常規範圍。多數組織會發現這類環境的修補週期與監控覆蓋率明顯低於主網路。另建議檢視隔離的實際程度：許多「隔離」環境仍保有管理用的跳板通道、共用的身分目錄或共用的備份基礎設施，任何一條都足以讓隔離在事件發生時失效。
action.en: Inventory the environments your organisation classifies as "isolated" or "standalone" — R&D lab segments, offline production systems, subsidiary networks not yet integrated after acquisition, project environments hosted by outsourced vendors — and confirm they are genuinely inside your routine scope for vulnerability management, log collection and access review. Most organisations find patch cadence and monitoring coverage in these environments run visibly behind the main network. Also test how isolated they actually are: many "isolated" environments retain a management jump path, a shared identity directory or shared backup infrastructure, and any one of those is enough to void the isolation when an incident occurs.
